additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
We have checked the logs, and the error flag
DC1-2_CoolingUnit_EP1_Lvl-Sw
is active and indicates that the coolant level in the tank is below the critical level and needs to be topped up. Please carry the following spare parts (8EM5905-0AA00-0AA2) while visiting the site.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0438605 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
AT

, due to one or more following reason (s):

.
If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com

.

Thank you.

The problem was that apparently a cable between the cooling unit and LOGO (KF10) and ET200 (KF5) was loose.
after checking the hole cable conncection we found the problem
